We run GWAS based on the set of differentially expressed TEs identified on the previous step 1170 sense and 507 anti-sense.
```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
# Expression sense and anti sense 
long_data_sense_anti_sense <- read.csv2("/groups/nordborg/projects/ddm1_resilencing/04_output/expression_matrix_output/ddm16909_vs_wt6909_fcmorethan1padjless005_batch_no_corr_filtered_ddm1ct_10readstotal_sene_and_anti_sense_long_data_corrected_sense_anti_sense_primary_distance_filtered.csv")
# Read metadata 
sequencing_date <- read.csv2("/groups/nordborg/projects/ddm1_resilencing/10_metadata/ddm1_crosses_metadata_2repl_filtered_num_reads_mapping_rate_filtered_outliers_by_pca.txt", header=T, sep=",") %>% dplyr::select(Sample_id,Sequencing_date)
## Rename column 
long_data_sense_anti_sense <- long_data_sense_anti_sense %>%
  dplyr::rename(expression_value = log2cpm,TE = id)
```
The phenotype is highly 0 scewed, therefore we need transformation
```{r}
## Distribution of the phenotype
long_data_sense_anti_sense %>%filter(long_data_sense_anti_sense$genotype=="ddm1") %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = (expression_value), fill = genotype, color = genotype)) +
  geom_histogram(aes(y = after_stat(density)), bins = 20, alpha = 0.7, color = "black") +
  geom_density(linewidth = 1, fill = NA) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Col" = "#FFB823", "ddm1" = "darkblue"),
                    labels = c("Col" = "Col0 WT X accession", "ddm1" = "Col0 ddm1 X accession")) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Col" = "#FFB823", "ddm1" = "darkblue"),
                     labels = c("Col" = "Col0 WT X accession", "ddm1" = "Col0 ddm1 X accession")) +
  labs(title = "Expression per TE by Genotype", 
       x = "Log2 expression, anti-sense and sense, ddm1", 
       y = "Density") + 
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12)
```
The phenotype was constructed using following transformations:

log2 transformation

z -scale transformation

BoxCox transformation
```{r}
## Transform values
library(forecast)
long_data_sense_anti_sense$genotype <- ifelse(long_data_sense_anti_sense$genotype=="ct_col", "Col0", long_data_sense_anti_sense$genotype)
long_data_combined <- long_data_sense_anti_sense[long_data_sense_anti_sense$genotype=="Col0" | long_data_sense_anti_sense$genotype=="ddm1",] # Select only ddm1
# Apply transformation
long_data_combined_transformed <- long_data_combined %>%  
  group_by(TE, genotype) %>% 
  mutate(
    zscale = (expression_value - mean(expression_value)) / sd(expression_value),
    log2 = expression_value,  # Already log2!
    #shifted = expression_value - min(expression_value) + 1,
    #lambda = BoxCox.lambda(shifted, lower = -0.5, upper = 0.5),
    #boxcox = BoxCox(shifted, lambda[1]),
    INT = qnorm((rank(expression_value, ties.method = "average") - 0.5) / n())  # rank-based
  ) %>%
  ungroup()
```

```{r}
## Add seuqencing date 
long_data_combined_transformed$sample <- gsub(".*_", "", long_data_combined_transformed$sample_id)
long_data_combined_transformed$sample <- as.numeric(long_data_combined_transformed$sample)
long_data_combined_transformed <- left_join(long_data_combined_transformed,sequencing_date,by=c("sample"="Sample_id"))
```
Then, BLUPs were calculated for each TE accordingly. Based on the plot (fitted vs residuals) log2 transformed values and z-scale transformed values were taken.
###BLUPs calculation on zscaled values
```{r, warning=FALSE,message=FALSE}
library(lme4)
library(tidyr)
library(purrr)
library(tidyverse)



blups_zscale <- long_data_combined_transformed %>%filter(genotype == "ddm1")%>%
  group_by(TE) %>% 
  nest() %>%
  mutate(
    model = map(data, ~ lmer(zscale ~ (1 | accession) + (1 | replicate) + (1 | Sequencing_date/plate), 
                             data = .x,
                             control = lmerControl(optimizer = "bobyqa", 
                                                   optCtrl = list(maxfun = 2e5)))),
    blups_zscale = map(model, ~ ranef(.)$accession %>%
                  as.data.frame() %>%
                  rownames_to_column("accession") %>%
                  setNames(c("accession", "BLUP"))),
    fitted_resid = map2(model, data, ~ .y %>%
                          mutate(
                            fitted = fitted(.x),
                            residuals = residuals(.x)
                          )))

# Extract BLUPs for analysis
blups_long_zscale <- blups_zscale %>%
  dplyr::select(TE, blups_zscale) %>%
  unnest(blups_zscale) %>%
  dplyr::select(TE, accession, BLUP)

# Extract fitted 
fitted_resid_long_zscale <- blups_zscale %>%
  dplyr::select(TE, fitted_resid) %>%
  unnest(fitted_resid)

fitted_resid_long_zscale %>% 
  ggplot(aes(fitted, residuals)) + 
  geom_point(alpha = 0.3) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "red") +
  facet_wrap(~genotype, scales = "free") +
  labs(title = "Residuals vs Fitted Values, z scale")

# Histogram of residuals
ggplot(fitted_resid_long_zscale, aes(x = residuals)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 30, fill = "steelblue", color = "black") +
  facet_wrap(~genotype) +
  labs(title = "Histogram of Residuals, z scale",
       x = "Residuals",
       y = "Count")

```
###BLUPs calculation on log2
```{r,warning=FALSE,message=FALSE}
library(tidyr)
library(purrr)
library(lme4)
# Caluclate BLUPs
blups_log2 <- long_data_combined_transformed %>%  
  group_by(TE) %>% 
  nest() %>%
  mutate(
    model = map(data, ~ lmer(log2 ~ (1 | accession) + (1 | replicate) + (1 | Sequencing_date/plate), 
                             data = .x,
                             control = lmerControl(optimizer = "bobyqa", 
                                                   optCtrl = list(maxfun = 2e5)))),
    blups_log2 = map(model, ~ ranef(.)$accession %>%
                  as.data.frame() %>%
                  rownames_to_column("accession") %>%
                  setNames(c("accession", "BLUP"))),
    fitted_resid = map2(model, data, ~ .y %>%
                          mutate(
                            fitted = fitted(.x),
                            residuals = residuals(.x)
                          )))

# Extract BLUPs for analysis
blups_long_log2 <- blups_log2 %>%
  dplyr::select(TE, blups_log2) %>%
  unnest(blups_log2) %>%
  dplyr::select(TE, accession, BLUP)

# Extract fitted 
fitted_resid_long_log2 <- blups_log2 %>%
  dplyr::select(TE, fitted_resid) %>%
  unnest(fitted_resid)

fitted_resid_long_log2 %>% 
  ggplot(aes(fitted, residuals)) +  # Remove the data argument here
  geom_point(alpha = 0.3) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "red") +
  facet_wrap(~genotype, scales = "free") +
  labs(title = "Residuals vs Fitted Values, log2")

# Histogram of residuals
ggplot(fitted_resid_long_log2, aes(x = residuals)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 30, fill = "steelblue", color = "black") +
  facet_wrap(~genotype) +
  labs(title = "Histogram of Residuals, log2",
       x = "Residuals",
       y = "Count")
```

###BLUPs calculation on rank transformed values
```{r}
# Single model across all TEs
model_rank <- lmer(INT ~ (1 | accession)  + (1 | replicate) + 
                     (1 | Sequencing_date/plate),
                   data = long_data_combined_transformed,
                   control = lmerControl(optimizer = "bobyqa",
                                         optCtrl = list(maxfun = 2e5)))

# Extract BLUPs per accession
blups_rank <- ranef(model_rank)$accession %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  rownames_to_column("accession") %>%
  setNames(c("accession", "BLUP"))

# Fitted + residuals
long_data_combined_transformed$fitted <- fitted(model_rank)
long_data_combined_transformed$residuals <- residuals(model_rank)

ggplot(long_data_combined_transformed, aes(x = fitted, y = residuals)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.05, size = 0.3) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, color = "red", linetype = "dashed") +
  labs(title = "Residuals vs Fitted (INT model)",
       x = "Fitted", y = "Residuals") +
  theme_bw()


mean_INT_per_accession <- long_data_combined_transformed %>%
  group_by(accession) %>%
  summarise(mean_INT = mean(INT, na.rm = TRUE))
blups_rank$accession<- as.numeric(blups_rank$accession)
blups_rank %>%
  left_join(mean_INT_per_accession, by = "accession") %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = mean_INT, y = BLUP)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.6) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", color = "red") +
  labs(title = "BLUP vs mean INT per accession",
       x = "Mean INT", y = "BLUP") +
  theme_bw()

ggplot(data.frame(residuals = residuals(model_rank)), aes(x = residuals)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 50, fill = "steelblue", color = "black") +
  labs(title = "Histogram of Residuals (rank model)",
       x = "Residuals", y = "Count") +
  theme_bw()
```

###Superfamily average, log2
```{r}
te_annotation <- read.table("/groups/nordborg/projects/ddm1_resilencing/11_resources/ref_genome/TAIR10_Transposable_Elements.txt", header = T)
# log2 data with te 
blups_long_log2_with_te <- left_join(blups_long_log2,te_annotation, by=c("TE"="Transposon_Name"))
# zscale data with te 
blups_long_zscale_with_te <- left_join(blups_long_zscale,te_annotation, by=c("TE"="Transposon_Name"))
```

```{r}
blups_avg_log2_superfamily <- blups_long_log2_with_te %>% 
  group_by(accession, Transposon_Super_Family) %>% 
  dplyr::summarise(
    ddm1_avg = mean(BLUP, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
```
How many TEs per family?
```{r}
tes_per_superfamily <- blups_long_log2_with_te %>%
  group_by(Transposon_Super_Family) %>%
  summarise(n = n_distinct(TE)) %>%   # replace TE_name with your actual TE ID column
  dplyr::select(Transposon_Super_Family, n)
tes_per_superfamily

ggplot(tes_per_superfamily, aes(x = reorder(Transposon_Super_Family, -n), y = n)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", fill = "#5A0E24") +
  geom_text(aes(label = n), vjust = -0.5, size = 3.5) +
  labs(x = "Transposon Super Family", y = "Number of TEs", title = "TEs per Superfamily") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))+ylim(0,700)
```


```{r}
blups_avg_log2_superfamily$accession <- as.numeric(blups_avg_log2_superfamily$accession)
## Remove accessions from Tom's heterozygosity list
accessions_not_distingquished <- read.table("/groups/nordborg/common_data/fernandos_SNP_calls/heterozygous_accessions.txt")
#samples that doesnt exisit in the file plus 9981 which behaves wierd 
long_df_final <- blups_avg_log2_superfamily[!blups_avg_log2_superfamily$accession %in% accessions_not_distingquished$V1, ]

long_df_final$null1<-0
long_df_final$null2<-0
long_df_final$null3<-0
long_df_final$null4<-0

long_df_final <- long_df_final %>% dplyr::select(null1,accession,null2,null3,null4,ddm1_avg,Transposon_Super_Family)
# Order accessions in specific manner
accessions <- read.table("/groups/nordborg/projects/ddm1_resilencing/03_processing/006_gwas/all_plates_96w/gemma_gwas/blup_gwas/core_files/accession_list.txt")
colnames(accessions) <- "accession"
long_df_final <- long_df_final[order(match(long_df_final$accession, accessions$accession)), ]
# Loop through each TE and write to its own folder
long_df_final$TE <- gsub("/", "_", long_df_final$Transposon_Super_Family)
unique_TEs <- unique(long_df_final$TE)

base_path <- "/groups/nordborg/projects/ddm1_resilencing/03_processing/006_gwas/all_plates_96w/gemma_gwas/blup_gwas/blups_ddm1_superfamily_average/log2"

long_df_final <- long_df_final %>% ungroup()

for (te in unique_TEs) {
  te_df <- long_df_final %>%
    dplyr::filter(TE == te) %>%
    dplyr::select(null1, accession, null2, null3, null4,ddm1_avg)
  # Create full path for TE
  te_dir <- file.path(base_path, te)
  dir.create(te_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
  # Write the file inside the TE folder
  write.table(te_df,
              file = file.path(te_dir, "1163g.179kB.prior15.gauss4.ts99.5.BIALLELIC.selected.fam"),
              quote = FALSE,
              sep = "\t",
              row.names = FALSE,
              col.names = FALSE)}
```

```{r}
long_df_final <- long_df_final[order(match(long_df_final$accession, accessions$accession)), ]
# Loop through each TE and write to its own folder
long_df_final$TE <- gsub("/", "_", long_df_final$Transposon_Family)
unique_TEs <- unique(long_df_final$TE)

base_path <- "/groups/nordborg/projects/ddm1_resilencing/03_processing/006_gwas/all_plates_96w/gemma_gwas/blup_gwas/blups_ddm1_family_average/log2"

long_df_final <- long_df_final %>% ungroup()

for (te in unique_TEs) {
  te_df <- long_df_final %>%
    dplyr::filter(TE == te) %>%
    dplyr::select(null1, accession, null2, null3, null4,ddm1_avg)
  # Create full path for TE
  te_dir <- file.path(base_path, te)
  dir.create(te_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
  # Write the file inside the TE folder
  write.table(te_df,
              file = file.path(te_dir, "1163g.179kB.prior15.gauss4.ts99.5.BIALLELIC.selected.fam"),
              quote = FALSE,
              sep = "\t",
              row.names = FALSE,
              col.names = FALSE)}
```

## Individual TEs log2 transformed 
```{r}
blups_long_log2$accession <- as.numeric(blups_long_log2$accession)
## Remove accessions from Tom's heterozygosity list
accessions_not_distingquished <- read.table("/groups/nordborg/common_data/fernandos_SNP_calls/heterozygous_accessions.txt")
#samples that doesnt exisit in the file plus 9981 which behaves wierd 
long_df_final <- blups_long_log2[!blups_long_log2$accession %in% accessions_not_distingquished$V1, ]

long_df_final$null1<-0
long_df_final$null2<-0
long_df_final$null3<-0
long_df_final$null4<-0

long_df_final <- long_df_final %>% dplyr::select(null1,accession,null2,null3,null4,BLUP,TE)
# Order accessions in specific manner
accessions <- read.table("/groups/nordborg/projects/ddm1_resilencing/03_processing/006_gwas/all_plates_96w/gemma_gwas/blup_gwas/core_files/accession_list.txt")
colnames(accessions) <- "accession"
long_df_final <- long_df_final[order(match(long_df_final$accession, accessions$accession)), ]
# Loop through each TE and write to its own folder
long_df_final$TE <- gsub("/", "_", long_df_final$TE)
unique_TEs <- unique(long_df_final$TE)

base_path <- "/groups/nordborg/projects/ddm1_resilencing/03_processing/006_gwas/all_plates_96w/gemma_gwas/blup_gwas/blups_ddm1_individual_tes/log2"

long_df_final <- long_df_final %>% ungroup()

for (te in unique_TEs) {
  te_df <- long_df_final %>%
    dplyr::filter(TE == te) %>%
    dplyr::select(null1, accession, null2, null3, null4,BLUP)
  # Create full path for TE
  te_dir <- file.path(base_path, te)
  dir.create(te_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
  # Write the file inside the TE folder
  write.table(te_df,
              file = file.path(te_dir, "1163g.179kB.prior15.gauss4.ts99.5.BIALLELIC.selected.fam"),
              quote = FALSE,
              sep = "\t",
              row.names = FALSE,
              col.names = FALSE)}
```

## Number of re-silenced TEs
```{r}
library(dplyr)
long_data_sense <- read.csv2("/groups/nordborg/projects/ddm1_resilencing/04_output/expression_matrix_output/ddm16909_vs_wt6909_selected_raw_fcmorethan1padjless005_batch_no_corr_filtered_ddm1ct_10readstotal_sene_long_data_with_controls.csv")
long_data_anti_sense <- read.csv2("/groups/nordborg/projects/ddm1_resilencing/04_output/expression_matrix_output/ddm16909_vs_wt6909_selected_raw_fcmorethan1padjless005_batch_no_corr_filtered_ddm1ct_10readstotal_anti_sense_long_data_with_controls.csv")

long_data_anti_sense <- long_data_anti_sense %>%
  mutate(TE = gsub("_AS$", "", TE))
# TEs unique to each
sense_only_TEs <- setdiff(long_data_sense$TE, long_data_anti_sense$TE)
anti_only_TEs  <- setdiff(long_data_anti_sense$TE, long_data_sense$TE)
# Filter and combine
long_data_combined <- bind_rows(
  long_data_sense %>% filter(TE %in% sense_only_TEs),
  long_data_anti_sense %>% filter(TE %in% anti_only_TEs)
)
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)

# log2 transform data 
long_data_combined$expression_value <- log2(long_data_combined$expression_value+1)
# Get controls 
long_data_combined_control <- long_data_combined %>%
  filter(accession == 6909 & genotype %in% c("ct_col", "ddm1_ct"))

# Select controls to the separate dfs
long_data_combined_control_d <- long_data_combined_control %>%
  filter(genotype == "ddm1_ct")

long_data_combined_control_col <- long_data_combined_control %>%
  filter(genotype == "ct_col")

# Apply expression filters
long_data_combined_control_ddm1 <- long_data_combined_control_ddm1 %>%
  group_by(TE) %>%
  filter(all(expression_value > 1)) %>%    # ALL replicates > 1 in ddm1
  ungroup()

long_data_combined_control_col <- long_data_combined_control_col %>%
  group_by(TE) %>%
  filter(all(expression_value >= 0 & expression_value <= 1)) %>%   # ALL replicates 0-1 in ct_col
  ungroup()

# Get reference TEs present in both conditions
re_silenced_tes_ref <- inner_join(
  long_data_combined_control_ddm1 %>% distinct(TE),
  long_data_combined_control_col %>% distinct(TE),
  by = "TE"
)

## Make a heatmap of these TEs 
resilenced_TEs_ref <- long_data_combined %>% filter(accession==6909) %>%
  filter(TE %in% re_silenced_tes_ref$TE) %>% select(TE, sample_id, expression_value)

## Make a heatmap
library(ComplexHeatmap)

# Pivot data to wide format (matrix)
heatmap_matrix <- resilenced_TEs_ref %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = sample_id, values_from = expression_value, values_fill = 0) %>%
  column_to_rownames("TE") %>%
  as.matrix()

Heatmap(
      heatmap_matrix, 
      name = "log2(counts)", 
      cluster_columns = TRUE,
      cluster_rows = TRUE,
      clustering_distance_columns = "euclidean",
      show_column_names = TRUE,
      show_row_names = FALSE,
      show_heatmap_legend = TRUE,
      row_km = 1,
      row_km_repeats = 1000,
      column_km_repeats = 1000,
      column_km = 2,
      #column_split = TRUE,
      column_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 5),
      row_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 5),
      heatmap_legend_param = list(
        title_gp = gpar(fontsize = 13),
        labels_gp = gpar(fontsize = 13)))
```

```{r}
# Now apply to all accessions: F1_ddm1 between 0-1, F1_Col == 0
long_data_combined$sample_id <- NULL

long_data_combined$genotype[long_data_combined$accession == 6909 & 
                             long_data_combined$genotype == "ct_col"] <- "Col"
# Step 1: Take mean across duplicates 
resilenced_TEs <- long_data_combined %>%
  filter(TE %in% re_silenced_tes_ref$TE) %>%
  filter(genotype %in% c("ddm1", "Col")) %>%
  group_by(TE, accession, genotype) %>%                                
  summarise(expression_value = mean(expression_value, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = genotype, values_from = expression_value)

resilenced_TEs <- resilenced_TEs %>%
  group_by(TE, accession) %>%
  filter(
    (ddm1 >= 0 & Col ==0 | ddm1 >= 1 & Col ==1 )) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  distinct(TE, accession) %>%       # one row per TE-accession combination
  group_by(accession) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(n_resilenced_TEs = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  arrange(desc(n_resilenced_TEs))

## Arrange

resilenced_TEs$accession <- as.numeric(resilenced_TEs$accession)
## Remove accessions from Tom's heterozygosity list
accessions_not_distingquished <- read.table("/groups/nordborg/common_data/fernandos_SNP_calls/heterozygous_accessions.txt")
#samples that doesnt exisit in the file plus 9981 which behaves wierd 
long_df_final <- resilenced_TEs[!resilenced_TEs$accession %in% accessions_not_distingquished$V1, ]

long_df_final$null1<-'0'
long_df_final$null2<-'0'
long_df_final$null3<-'0'
long_df_final$null4<-'0'

long_df_final <- long_df_final %>% dplyr::select(null1,accession,null2,null3,null4,n_resilenced_TEs)
# Order accessions in specific manner
accession_list <-read.table("/groups/nordborg/projects/ddm1_resilencing/03_processing/006_gwas/all_plates_96w/gemma_gwas/blup_gwas/core_files/accession_list.txt", header=T)
long_df_final <- long_df_final[order(match(long_df_final$accession, accession_list$accession)), ]

write.table(long_df_final, "/groups/nordborg/projects/ddm1_resilencing/03_processing/006_gwas/all_plates_96w/gemma_gwas/number_of_res_tes/1163g.179kB.prior15.gauss4.ts99.5.BIALLELIC.selected.fam",quote = FALSE,sep = "\t",row.names = FALSE,col.names = FALSE)

write.csv2(long_data_combined,"/groups/nordborg/projects/ddm1_resilencing/04_output/expression_matrix_output/number_of_resilenced_tes.csv", quote = F, row.names = F)
```
